subject: Vendor onboarding - VAT reverse charge & PO timing (SvenskaCloud)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Larsson <procurement@svenskacloud.se>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: VAT reverse-charge documentation & PO timing

Hi Anna / SvenskaCloud team,

Thanks for agreeing to onboard as a Redwood supplier. We're finalising internal procurement steps and I need a couple of quick items from you so we can issue a PO and process the first payment. High-level: Redwood EU Ltd will be the contracting entity for this engagement and, per EU VAT rules, we expect reverse-charge to apply on cross-border B2B services. To complete our vendor setup we need: 

- A copy of your Swedish VAT registration (VAT No / momsreg.nr).
- A PDF of a recent VAT certificate or a signed vendor statement confirming your VAT number.
- Completed vendor onboarding form (I attached our short onboarding form for completion).

Practical questions: if you can confirm the exact VAT number and upload the certificate, procurement will issue the PO as net of VAT (we will account for VAT under reverse-charge). If for any reason your team expects to charge Swedish VAT on invoices to Redwood EU Ltd, please explain and include a sample invoice.

Timing: once we receive the VAT certificate + completed onboarding form, procurement aims to issue the PO within 5-7 business days. If there are any additional compliance docs your accounting team needs from us (EU VAT number for Redwood EU Ltd, registered company address, etc.) say so and I'll send.

Attachments: SVK-vendor-onboarding-form-2026.pdf (please sign and return), vendor-checklist.xlsx (not attached here).

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Olga,

Thanks — happy to get this moving. Please find attached our VAT certificate and a signed copy of your onboarding form. Short answers below: 

- Our Swedish VAT number: SE556677889701
- We can confirm SvenskaCloud AB will not charge Swedish VAT on invoices to Redwood EU Ltd provided you supply a valid EU VAT number and the reverse-charge applies.
- If Redwood prefers us to bill VAT-inclusive for any reason, we can do that but it requires a different invoicing flow.

Attachments included: svenskacloud-vat-certificate-2026.pdf; SVK-vendor-onboarding-form-2026-signed.pdf

Let me know if you need anything else. We can also set a brief call tomorrow to confirm SAP invoice routing if helpful.

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: VAT reverse-charge documentation & PO timing

Great — received Anna's attachments and the certificate looks valid at a glance. Next internal questions before PO issuance: 

- Confirm Redwood EU Ltd VAT number to include on our records (we should put it on the PO and ask SvenskaCloud to reference it on the invoice).
- PO terms: should we issue the PO net of VAT and include a clause that supplier confirms reverse-charge applies and is responsible for issuing an EU-compliant VAT invoice?
- Rishi, for cashflow forecasting: if the vendor were to invoice VAT-inclusive unexpectedly, how would we handle crediting/invoice correction?

Karthik, tagging you for a legal phrasing check for the PO and invoice representation. Happy to block the PO until we get your go/no-go.

Thanks,
Priya
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: VAT reverse-charge documentation & PO timing

Priya / Olga — quick legal note on wording. Suggested PO / contract language (short form) we should include before issuing the PO: 

"Supplier confirms it is VAT-registered in Sweden (VAT No: SE556677889701) and shall issue VAT invoices in accordance with EU VAT rules. Where the supply is made to a taxable person in the EU and the reverse-charge mechanism applies, Supplier shall not charge VAT and Buyer (Redwood EU Ltd) shall account for VAT pursuant to the reverse-charge rules. Supplier warrants that it will provide a valid VAT invoice referencing the Buyer's VAT number and any other required information to support the reverse-charge. Any withholding tax (WHT) obligations are the parties' responsibility under applicable law; to the extent any WHT is imposed, the parties will cooperate to obtain treaty relief or documentation."
Practical point: include the Redwood EU VAT number on the PO (I believe it's IE999888777 — confirm with tax). Also add a line: "Prices are exclusive of VAT unless expressly stated." That keeps the PO clear. 

Rishi — for accounts payable: if we receive an invoice incorrectly VAT-charged, we should ask supplier for a corrected invoice. If the supplier insists, we can escalate to legal/finance to request credit note or offset; ideally procurement blocks payment until corrected.

Happy to iterate, but we can proceed with procurement issuing a PO net of VAT once we have the EU VAT number confirmed and the signed onboarding form.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: VAT reverse-charge documentation & PO timing

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick turnaround and for signing the form. Final confirmation and next steps: 

- Redwood EU Ltd VAT number: IE999888777 (please include on your invoices).
- Procurement will issue PO RED-PO-2026-1127 net of VAT within 7 business days (target: 2026-12-14).
- Please ensure your invoices reference both your VAT number and Redwood EU Ltd VAT; include the phrase "Reverse charge: Article 194 VAT Directive / Buyer liable for VAT" on the invoice if possible.
- Upload your invoices to our AP portal (SAP) and copy ap@redwoodinference.com. If you run into issues, schedule a 20-min handoff with our AP team: https://calendly.com/redwood-ap/20 

Attachments: I have initiated a DocuSign for the final onboarding packet — please sign the DocuSign envelope when you have a moment: https://app.docusign.com/transactions/ABC12345

If anything changes on your side (for example, if you will charge VAT), flag immediately so procurement can pause PO issuance. Otherwise we will proceed.

Thanks all — looping internal owners for visibility.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
